alt: 一個人明知同伴在故意破壞別人的作品，仍幫忙拿住畫紙，讓對方更容易欺負人。
scene_prompt: 為虎作倀 means knowingly helping a wrongdoer mistreat others. Modern school art room with three older teenagers. A bully deliberately scribbles one ugly dark mark over another student's carefully made ORIGINAL flower painting. His willing helper knowingly holds the painting steady for him, looking toward the bully for approval. The owner stands nearby upset and asking them to stop with a raised open hand. Emphasize the HELPER choosing to assist wrongdoing, not a bystander or someone trying to protect the artwork. No physical assault, threatening weapons, slurs, humiliating text or extreme distress. No real artwork copied, no text in picture. Serious educational empathy, not playful endorsement.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
